name: Orble Helper
author: thelaggingway
description: Orble sandboxes in the Omarchy bar: new boxes in three sizes, forks, snapshots and boxes made from them, shared ports, one-click SSH, suspend and resume, the desktop in your browser or a VNC viewer, the exit node, projects, private networks, egress rules, secrets, SSH keys and credit, through the signed-in orble CLI.

barWidget.description: Your Orble boxes and snapshots with one-click SSH, suspend and resume, shared ports, desktops, the exit node, networks, secrets, SSH keys and credit.

schema.label: Background refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often to check box states while the panel is closed. While it is open, or an action is running, it checks every 10 seconds.

schema.label: Show running count on the bar
Show the credit card
schema.description: Your credit, account and box hostnames, with Add credit. Adds no extra request.

schema.label: Low credit warning (dollars)
schema.description: Below this, the credit turns red and the bar icon is highlighted. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Orble project
schema.description: The project slug the panel opens in (orble project list). Empty: ORBLE_PROJECT, else your default project. The PROJECT row in the panel switches until the shell restarts.

schema.label: Demo data
schema.description: Show made-up boxes, keys and credit instead of your account, for screenshots. Actions do nothing while it is on.
